stories.title: Fed may get pulled into Bessent's push to support the yen
stories.summary: A CNBC analysis suggests Treasury Secretary Bessent's effort to shore up Japan's yen could end up drawing in the Federal Reserve. The piece frames this as a currency-support push that may not stay confined to the Treasury alone.
stories.whyItMatters: Fed involvement in FX support would blur the line between monetary policy and currency intervention, a combination that can move rate expectations and global currency markets.
whatToWatch: Any public comment from the Fed or Treasury on yen support
questions: What concrete steps would the Fed actually take?
Is this based on stated policy or still speculative analysis?

sources.title: Analysis: Federal Reserve may be pulled into Bessent’s effort to support Japan’s yen

stories.title: Palantir jumps 12% as US commercial revenue nearly triples
stories.summary: Palantir shares soared 12% after a blowout quarter, with U.S. commercial revenue climbing nearly 150%. Reports from CNBC and MarketWatch both point to AI-driven demand as the growth engine behind the results.
stories.whyItMatters: Palantir is a closely watched bellwether for whether AI enthusiasm is converting into actual enterprise revenue, not just stock hype.
whatToWatch: Forward guidance on next quarter's commercial bookings
Whether other AI-software peers report similar acceleration
questions: How much of the growth is new customers versus expanded contracts with existing ones?
Can the current growth rate be sustained given the stock's run-up?

stories.title: Big Tech's Anthropic and OpenAI stakes are distorting earnings
stories.summary: CNBC reports that equity stakes held by large tech companies in AI startups Anthropic and OpenAI are muddying the picture of underlying corporate earnings, as gains or losses on those stakes flow through results.
stories.whyItMatters: Investors need to separate paper gains or losses from AI-startup stakes from a company's core operating performance to judge earnings quality accurately.
